summary: Regression test for the previously-broken POST /api/orders/{order_id}/steps/{step_number}/forward endpoint. The missing @router.post decorator above forward_step in routes/orders/steps.py has been restored. Created /app/backend/tests/test_forward_step.py with 10 targeted tests across reachability, role gating, edge cases, and the translation hook. 9/10 passed, 1 skipped (translation populated-translation check — endpoint succeeded but the Emergent LLM translate() call returned an empty string; see action_items). Reachability + persistence + RBAC are fully verified.

minor.issue: When the order's client country is CN/FR/IT, the endpoint correctly invokes _translation.translate() (LiteLLM log line 'LiteLLM completion() model=claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 provider=openai' is emitted), the request returns 200, but steps.$.associate_review_note_translated is stored as an empty string. result.content from emergentintegrations LlmChat appears to come back empty (no 'translation failed' log either). This is NOT a regression of the forward fix — same behaviour exists in complete_step's translation path. Pre-existing translation integration issue.

action_items: Forward endpoint fix verified end-to-end — no further action needed for the decorator restoration.

Separate (pre-existing) bug: investigate why _translation.translate() returns empty strings for non-EN countries despite a successful LiteLLM round-trip. Likely candidates: emergentintegrations LlmChat result.content shape changed, or the 'anthropic'/'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929' model name is rejected silently. Reproduce by setting client country to CN/FR/IT and calling /forward or /complete with notes; result is HTTP 200 but the *_translated field is ''. Same behaviour observed via direct probe script.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/orders/steps.py:227 — @router.post("/orders/{order_id}/steps/{step_number}/forward") now correctly registers forward_step with the FastAPI router. Path parameters and ForwardUpdate body match the frontend's api.forwardStep payload ({review_note: string}) in src/api/client.ts.
Role gating in forward_step uses require_roles('associate', 'admin'); manufacturer/client are blocked at the dependency level before the order lookup, which is the correct order of checks.
Associate ownership gate (order['associate_id'] != user['id']) raises 403 with no detail body — consider adding detail='Forbidden' for parity with other endpoints (minor).
Update uses positional $ projection {'id': order_id, 'steps.step_number': step_number} with $set on steps.$.*; matched_count==0 correctly maps to 404 'Step not found' after the order existence check.
strip_order_for_role(updated, user) is applied to the response, preserving the same role-filtering contract as sibling step endpoints.

success_rate.backend: 90% (9 passed / 1 skipped — skip is due to a pre-existing translation-integration issue, not the forward-step fix)

seed_data_creation: Two module-scoped throwaway orders are created using the seed client + manufacturer (one assigned to associate@somnio.co for happy-path/own-order tests, one assigned to a different gem-gallery associate for the 403 'foreign order' test). Both are soft-deleted and purged in fixture teardown. The translation tests temporarily PATCH the seed client@somnio.co country to CN and restore to AU afterwards. No persistent data mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_forward_step.py as the canonical regression for the forward endpoint. Run with: `set -a && . /app/frontend/.env && set +a && pytest backend/tests/test_forward_step.py -v`. The translation-skip path will auto-pass once the upstream _translation.translate() bug is fixed.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: a refactor extracted forward_step from the monolithic orders.py into routes/orders/steps.py but dropped its `@router.post(...)` decorator. Because the function was never registered with the APIRouter, FastAPI's path table had no entry for POST /api/orders/{id}/steps/{n}/forward and every request 404'd. Frontend api.forwardStep silently failed in production. Fix: re-add `@router.post("/orders/{order_id}/steps/{step_number}/forward")` directly above the async function (line 227). Verification: endpoint now returns 200 for admin and assigned associate, 403 for foreign associate / manufacturer / client, 404 for unknown order or unknown step. MongoDB steps.$.forwarded_to_client, steps.$.forwarded_at, and steps.$.associate_review_note are all written and re-read correctly via subsequent GET.
